caveats: Slug implies 2024 but two sources (Minnesota Lawyer, Chisago County Press) state the federal civil rights suit was filed in 2023 in U.S. District Court (D. Minn.), so year_filed=2023. Plaintiff Darcey Duncan (the ex-sheriff's sister-in-law, a civilian, not an employee) sued Chisago County over ex-Sheriff Richard 'Rick' Duncan's 2017 fabricated-blackmail sexual assault scheme; court found county liability under Monell. $7.5M settlement approved/announced Feb-March 2026, paid via the Minnesota Counties Intergovernmental Trust. Duncan pleaded guilty (Nov 2023) to one count of criminal sexual conduct (originally five counts), sentenced to ~6 months (178 days) jail, 15 years probation, predatory-offender registration; he had separate stalking/misconduct-of-a-public-officer convictions involving a coworker.
